decisions.reason: The decision extends prize-ticket allocation to primary mints using no referral code or an invalid code, while the candidate currently records ticket awards only for completed referrals.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Also, regarding the ' Valid referral number' popup:
[ACCOUNT_001] Only NFTs that have already been minted should count as valid.

[ACCOUNT_001] When a code is valid, the message should say: 'Valid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to your selected referer.'

[ACCOUNT_001] If there is no code or it is invalid, the message should say: 'No/Invalid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to an existing NFT holder at random.'

value_updates.no_or_invalid_referral_ticket_allocation: For a primary mint with no referral code or an invalid referral code, award the $500 prize-draw ticket to a random existing NFT holder.
